headline: Valve has not said what caused Steam's Nov 17 outage or the Nov 20-21 problems. Nobody has reported a hack.
summary: First draft. 6 sources (1 Tier 1, 4 Tier 2, 1 Tier 3), 13 claims (2 Confirmed, 8 Reported, 3 Not established), 6 questions. The Nov 17 outage is Confirmed by XDA's first-hand check, IT Home and an independent tracker. Whether either disruption was a cyberattack is Not established: no cause, no claim, no statement either way, and tracker spikes are not evidence of an attack. The Nov 20-21 reports rest on user-report trackers relayed by two outlets; Valve had not commented. We found no DDoS claim to carry as a rumor. Privacy check done: no names of private people, no handles, no contact details.
author: Research agent
